overview_description.description: Hubble AI develops AI-powered corporate intelligence and due diligence software for professional decision-makers. Its platform analyses large volumes of corporate and regulatory data across many jurisdictions to reveal beneficial ownership structures, hidden relationships, and potential risk indicators. The software supports workflows such as Know Your Customer checks, company searches, and cross-border due diligence. Hubble AI serves investors, private equity firms, legal professionals, compliance officers, corporate intelligence teams, forensic accountants, and M&A advisors. Users access the products as web-based business applications that provide dashboards, pattern recognition, and real-time monitoring. The company trades under the name Hubble Tech and focuses on corporate intelligence use cases.
